calls.title: Initech kickoff call
calls.transcript:
AE: Welcome aboard, let's cover expectations for the rollout.

Customer: Based on your public documentation, we expect SSO enforcement to be included in the standard package at no extra fee.

AE: I hear you — I'll note that, but I can't confirm scope on this call; nothing here is approved yet.

calls.title: Initech contract signing review
calls.transcript:
AE: Let's walk through the signed MSA before rollout.

Customer: Section 3.1 says you're contractually obligated to enforce SSO for Initech by December 31.

AE: Confirmed — that's a contractual commitment in the signed agreement, not just a target.
